index.description: The index (a collection on Typesense). search_list_indexes lists them.

query.description: The words to search for. Empty or left out: every document the filter matches.

filter.description: Documents whose fields match, in MongoDB's form: {"genre": "drama", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Operators $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $in $nin $exists, and $and / $or with a list. The engine evaluates it, on fields it can filter.

facets.description: Fields to count the values of among all matches.

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, in order. Algolia sorts by its replica indices instead: query the replica.

fields.description: Only these fields of each document.

searchFields.description: Search the words in these fields only. Typesense needs them unless GateRook may read the collection's schema.

offset.description: Documents to skip: nextOffset of the previous page.

vector.description: Search near this vector (Meilisearch, Typesense, Azure AI Search), alone or with query for a hybrid search.

vectorField.description: The vector field (Typesense, Azure AI Search) or the embedder (Meilisearch) of vector.
